articles.body:
Good evening everyone,

Does the company have to pay a pound for each extra ship and local alliance hired?
I don´t think that would make much sense to pay the revenue for those assets, as they´re temporary, but I couldn´t find a clear answer using the rulebook.

Best regards

articles.body: It's part of the operating cost. They really cost 3 pounds, 2 upfront to lease the ship and 1 for operating expenses (men, food, arms, munitions and other supplies, levies...) that is taken later from the company's bankroll. Just because ithe boat itself is a temporary lease doesn't mean you can skip on those costs.
